component.name: Glyph - Text Extractor
component.summary: Screen text extractor and OCR utility

description.p: Glyph is a screen text extractor and OCR utility for Linux desktops. Inspired by Microsoft PowerToys Text Extractor, Glyph allows you to select any screen region, extract text using optical character recognition, and copy it to your clipboard.

ul.li: Instant Capture (Mode A): crop a screen area and copy recognized text directly to the system clipboard.
Review and Edit (Mode B): inspect text, join split lines, and trim whitespace in a native Libadwaita window before copying.
Geometry-aware page segmentation: dynamically chooses single-line, block, or page layout modes based on crop dimensions.
Wayland and X11 support via XDG Desktop Portal with fallbacks for spectacle, grim, slurp, maim, and scrot.
Desktop notifications with escaped markup and application icon integration.
Local, offline processing with zero telemetry and private temporary storage.
Native GTK4 and Libadwaita interface adhering to GNOME Human Interface Guidelines.

description.p: KDE Plasma shortcut architecture overhaul with dedicated command launchers, nested services groups, D-Bus setShortcutKeys, and active daemon reload.

ul.li: Introduced dedicated command shortcut launchers with X-KDE-GlobalAccel-CommandShortcut for Plasma 6
Structured kglobalshortcutsrc entries targeting both nested [services] groups and root groups for cross-version compatibility
Added X-KDE-Shortcuts desktop specification extensions for Meta+Shift+T and Meta+Shift+I
Integrated multi-signal daemon reload pipeline including kbuildsycoca6, KWin.reconfigure, and plasma-kglobalaccel.service refresh
Added direct D-Bus setShortcutKeys activation over org.kde.kglobalaccel for immediate runtime binding

description.p: KDE Plasma shortcut integration fix, native Spectacle screen capture, automated shortcut setup, and VM software rendering fallback.

ul.li: Fixed KDE Plasma shortcut registration with standard Qt key sequences and desktop action mappings
Added native KDE Spectacle screenshot engine support for fast background snapshots
Automated global shortcut registration prompt in installer
Added VM software rendering fallback (GSK_RENDERER=cairo) to prevent Mesa Zink errors in virtual machines

description.p: Cross-distribution RPM package compatibility, dynamic Python runtime detection, and Flathub packaging preparation.

ul.li: Enhanced RPM spec with rich Boolean dependencies resolving python3-Pillow, tesseract-ocr, and libadwaita on openSUSE
Dynamic Python 3 interpreter resolution in launchers, preventing missing module errors on multi-Python systems
Added startup runtime dependency validation with distribution-specific package installation commands
Prepared Flathub Flatpak packaging with GNOME 49 runtime and store branding metadata

description.p: Cross-distribution packaging stability release for Arch Linux, Fedora, and Debian environments.

ul.li: Automatic shell PATH configuration ensuring ~/.local/bin is registered across bash and zsh
Arch Linux package dependency alignment adding tesseract-data-eng
Aligned cross-desktop and tiling window manager shortcut documentation with v0.2.0 defaults

description.p: OCR engine upgrade with geometry-aware PSM layout detection, edge enhancement, and silent Wayland portal integration.

ul.li: Smart geometry-based PSM layout detection prioritizing single-line (PSM 7) and block (PSM 6) modes for screen clippings
Screen-optimized Tesseract configuration with interword space preservation
Unsharp mask edge sharpening for antialiased screen fonts and Otsu binarization fallback for low-contrast text
Multi-pass recognition cascade and TSV structured data extraction with word-level confidence
D-Bus PermissionStore pre-authorization for background snapshot capture in GNOME Wayland

description.p: Desktop notification escaping, line break preservation, and cross-distribution conflict detection.

ul.li: Preserved line breaks and paragraph spacing across OCR passes
Hardened desktop notifications with XML and HTML character escaping
Added dual-installation collision detection and diagnostic warnings in CLI and installer
Optimized desktop shortcut handler to resolve running executable paths dynamically

description.p: In-memory capture pipeline optimization, icon assets, and GNOME Wayland integration.

ul.li: In-memory capture pipeline reducing capture latency
High-resolution PNG and scalable SVG icon suite
Enhanced GNOME desktop launcher integration
Hardened shortcut registration with absolute binary path resolution

description.p: Desktop notification improvements, documentation updates, and portable tarball archive packaging.

ul.li: Application icon and desktop-entry hint in system notifications
Multi-distribution upgrade instructions in documentation
Portable tarball archive packaging support

description.p: Cross-desktop global shortcut engine and universal multi-distribution packaging.

ul.li: Interactive desktop shortcut configuration with collision detection
Support for GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, Hyprland, Sway, and i3
Debian (.deb), Fedora/openSUSE (.rpm), and Arch Linux PKGBUILD packaging
Standalone portable Linux archive with self-contained launcher
